question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.

The __**negligent **__attitude of the cops was criticised.
solution:
The correct answer is attentive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'negligent' means '**not being careful or giving enough attention** to people or things that are your responsibility'
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• sloppy- that shows lack of care, thought or effort; untidy
 
• persistent*- *determined to continue doing something even though people say that you are wrong or that you cannot do it*.*
 
• *attentive- watching, **listening** to or **thinking about somebody/something carefully**.*
 
• Apprentice*- *feeling tired and perhaps slightly annoyed because something is not interesting or because you do not have anything to do*.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym of the word 'negligent' is 'attentive'.
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.
